捕手は本塁を守る人なのに、なぜ本塁をふさいではいけないのか

A catcher protects home plate. But that does not mean the catcher can block the runner's path at any time. 日本と米国の規則を起点に、three baseball scenarios と three approval designs を比べる。The surprising question is not simply who has authority, but when that authority may stop someone else.
